system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: bandwidth-aware overlap model for concurrent communication operators in an LLM performance simulator

content.subject: how overlapping communication operators share NVLink and IB bandwidth, and how the simulator slows each one down accordingly

elements.name: Comm Op 0
elements.role: communication operator using both NVLink and IB

elements.name: Comm Op 2
elements.role: NVLink operator overlapping the tail of Op 0

elements.name: NVLink segment
elements.role: green bar: time on NVLink at a given bandwidth

elements.name: IB segment
elements.role: blue bar: time on IB at a given bandwidth

elements.name: Req BW / Congest Aware
elements.role: worked bandwidth split: requested vs granted per op

elements.name: Full Speed / Slowdown legend
elements.role: solid bars = full speed, dotted pale bars = slowed down

relations.what: Op 0 and Op 1 both request 50 GB/s of IB and get 25 each
Op 0 requests 50 and Op 2 200 on NVLink; granted 40 and 160

panels.label: (a) Original
panels.differs: each operator runs at its own full bandwidth as if alone

panels.label: (b) Congestion Aware
panels.differs: overlapping portions are slowed to the shared bandwidth, so Op 0 ends later and Op 2 runs at 160 instead of 200 GB/s

values.what: per-segment bandwidths (50, 25, 40, 200, 160 GB/s) and the requested vs granted split
values.linked_by: coloured arrows from the slowed bars to the arithmetic

content.key_idea: When communication operators overlap on the same link, each gets a share of the bandwidth, so the simulator stretches the overlapped portions instead of assuming full speed.
content.reading_order: Legend above; (a) three rows at full speed; (b) the same rows with slowed segments and the bandwidth arithmetic beside Op 1 and Op 2.

palette.used_for: NVLink outlines, arithmetic text and arrows
IB outlines, arithmetic text and arrows

style.stroke: bar outlines in the bar's own darker hue, solid for full speed and dotted for slowdown; dotted black row separators
style.arrows: thick black time axes; coloured arrows from bars to the arithmetic; black 'Congest Aware' arrows between requested and granted
style.font: Calibri, regular for row labels and bandwidth values, bold for legend, panel titles and arithmetic

encoding.color_means: hue = link (green NVLink, blue IB); text in the link colour belongs to that link
encoding.line_style_means: dotted outline + pale fill = slowed segment; dotted horizontal rules separate operators
encoding.state_means: full speed vs slowed down, by fill strength and outline style
encoding.marker_means: none; bandwidth numbers inside the bars
encoding.emphasis: the arithmetic beside the rows is bold and coloured
reusable_patterns: before/after timelines on aligned axes, state shown by solid vs pale-dotted bars of the same hue
worked arithmetic written in the hue of the resource it concerns, arrows from the bars it explains
weaknesses: the long green arrow looping from Op 0 to Op 2's arithmetic crosses the row separators

evidence: the slowdown for each operator is decided by the effective bandwidth as well as the link congestion

summary: Two aligned timelines of three communication operators. In (a) every operator runs at full bandwidth on NVLink (green) and IB (blue). In (b) the overlapping portions are drawn as pale dotted bars at the shared bandwidth -- Op 0 and Op 1 split IB 25/25, Op 0 and Op 2 get 40/160 on NVLink -- with the requested-versus-granted arithmetic written in the link's colour beside the rows.
summary_zh: 机制图，上下两条对齐的时间线：(a) 三个通信算子都按满带宽画；(b) 重叠的部分画成浅色虚线条、按分到的带宽变慢，旁边用链路自己的颜色写出请求和实际分到的带宽。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon': the mechanism side of the style (saturated hue per resource, pale dotted for the degraded state).
